title: GEMM SiLU CPU oracle overflows on admitted negative contractions

evidence.note: Independent source/CPU probe at d76cb9ad: R1/K256/N2, a=-2, b=2, bias=0 passes contract and static lowering but math.exp(1024) raises OverflowError. Also reproduced under triton-b200; no device was dispatched.
Independent repair verification at 8f4fc410: totals -1024,-90,0,90,1024 finite; signed zero retained; 24 transfer/contraction tests pass.

observation: The frozen finite-input domain permits negative dot products below -709. Direct total/(1+exp(-total)) overflows the CPU oracle even though SiLU is finite. This is an oracle implementation failure, not a candidate numerical failure or a GPU performance observation.
proposed_change: Evaluate SiLU with a sign-stable exponential without changing the mathematical definition, input domain or tolerance.
verification_plan: CPU replay of the admitted boundary inputs plus public oracle and transfer contract regressions. Closure covers the oracle bug only; it provides no GPU or E2E qualification.
